newsitem.title: UK: European jet fuel dips with futures, prems hold.
newsitem.headline: European jet fuel dips with futures, prems hold.

text.p: European jet fuel prices dipped by $2.50 on Wednesday, pressured lower by weaker IPE gas oil futures.
May IPE gas oil last traded $2.50 down at $162.50 a tonne having spent much of the day under the shadow of bearish APIs.
Jet premiums were steady for barges at May IPE +$18 fob ARA with cargo differentials around May IPE +$22-23 cif NWE. Traders said there was a touch of supply tightness.
In the Mediterranean EU grade material was pegged around high fob quotes +$8 while Libyan was about $2-3 below this.
